topics.title: Basic data types
objectives: Recognize integers, floating-point numbers, strings and Boolean values.
Use type() to inspect a value and distinguish quoted digits from numbers.
Explain None and why a new assignment can change the type of a name.

topics.title: Input and type conversion
objectives: Explain that input() returns a string and that its prompt is printed.
Convert suitable values with int(), float() and str().
Recognize failed conversions and choose a deliberate conversion order.

topics.title: Arithmetic operators
objectives: Use addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, floor division, remainder and powers.
Read operator precedence and use parentheses to express intent.
Distinguish floor division from truncation, including negative operands.

topics.title: Comparison and logical operators
objectives: Compare values with ==, !=, <, <=, > and >=.
Combine Boolean expressions with and, or and not.
Recognize truthiness and short-circuit evaluation without confusing them with assignment.

topics.title: Conditions
objectives: Write if/elif/else branches with colons and consistent indentation.
Predict which branch runs and distinguish a chain from separate if statements.
Use nested conditions sparingly and order boundary checks correctly.

topics.title: Loops
objectives: Use for and range() for a counted repetition.
Use while for repetition controlled by a changing condition.
Trace counters and accumulators, including zero-iteration cases.

topics.title: Loop control
objectives: Use break to stop a loop and continue to skip one iteration.
Distinguish pass from loop control.
Explain when a loop's else block runs.

topics.title: Strings
objectives: Index and slice text safely.
Use common string methods and formatted strings.
Explain string immutability.

topics.title: Lists
objectives: Read and change ordered list items.
Distinguish append, extend and removal methods.
Recognize shared lists and shallow copies.

topics.title: Tuples and sets
objectives: Use immutable ordered tuples and unpacking.
Use sets for unique membership and set operations.
Avoid depending on set iteration order.

topics.title: Dictionaries
objectives: Store and retrieve values by keys.
Update entries and use get for optional keys.
Iterate through keys and key-value pairs.

topics.title: Functions
objectives: Define and call functions with parameters.
Distinguish returned values from printed output.
Use defaults and understand local names.

topics.title: Modules and imports
objectives: Import standard-library modules and selected names.
Use aliases and module-qualified names.
Recognize a local module and avoid name shadowing.

topics.title: Exceptions
objectives: Handle expected exceptions with try and except.
Distinguish else and finally.
Raise an appropriate exception for invalid input.

topics.title: File handling
objectives: Read and write UTF-8 text with with blocks.
Distinguish read, write and append modes.
Handle missing files and understand the read position.

topics.title: Basic object-oriented programming
objectives: Define classes and create instances.
Initialize instance attributes with __init__.
Call methods and distinguish instance and class attributes.
